results.overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.
results.name: Silo

results.overview: All his life, Adam and his three siblings are raised in an underground silo by a woman they call Mother, safe from the apocalyptic world above where mutated monsters called Red Eyes roam. Everything changes when an explosion erupts and Mother gets critically injured. Forced to venture up into the nuclear-active world, will they survive the shocks and dangers in store for them?
